title: Vril Society channels anti-gravity technology

tellings.quote: There are also claims about the Vril Society, a group said to have channeled anti-gravity technology and psychic powers from an ancient subterranean race.
So there are these claims that there was a group of mediums I think mostly women who were engaging in telepathic communication with basically a group of supermen.
tellings.difference: Says the mediums were mostly women in telepathic contact with 'supermen' and doesn't mention anti-gravity technology or a subterranean race.
tellings.link_reason: Vril Society mediums receiving knowledge by channeling or telepathy from a superior race, the same claim as the Vril channeling story.

as_told.title: Vril mediums in telepathic contact with supermen

plain: In Germany between the 1920s and 1940s, a group called the Vril Society is said to have received secret knowledge from unseen beings through psychic contact. Michels tells it himself as a claim he has come across: the group is "said to have channeled anti-gravity technology and psychic powers from an ancient subterranean race," meaning a people living underground. The researcher Jason Jorjani, a guest who talks about Nazi UFO stories, tells it without naming a source, and in his version it is a group of mediums, mostly women, in telepathic contact with "basically a group of supermen." He does not mention the anti-gravity technology or the underground race. If true, it would mean some of Germany's strange science came from contact with something not human.
